title: Report chart draws the seriesBy split: query the second dimension and pivot it into grouped series
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibx5r5nhDMwpRs4SL6D

Filing gate: ③ the renderer half of #27974, whose contract half lands in PR #28191 (claim 6526104358 names this follow-up; contract review 6528174510 PASS). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: any report that wants a bar per X split by Y. HotCRM `opportunity_funnel_owner_stage` (a bar per owner, split by stage) still falls back to an owner × stage `matrix` (hotcrm#2379) until the renderer reads the key.

## Observed (once PR #28191 is on `main`)

- `ReportChartSchema.seriesBy` is declared and checked at publish (`validateChartBindings`, `chart-dimension-unknown`), and its liveness row (`packages/spec/liveness/report.json`, `chart.children.seriesBy`) is `planned` with an author warning: declared, not yet drawn.
- `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` `DatasetReportChart` queries exactly `[xAxis]` × `[yAxis]` (≈L1210–1230, L1421), so the split is never drawn.

## Wanted

- The renderer widens the report chart query to `[xAxis, seriesBy]` × `[yAxis]` when `seriesBy` is set and passes the rows through `buildChartSeries` (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/chart-series.ts`, the existing two-dimension / one-measure pivot, ≈L592), with a test and an ablation.
- The liveness row `chart.children.seriesBy` moves from `planned` to `live` in the same PR, with the reader as evidence.
- Riders named by the contract review 6528174510 (should-fix, non-blocking): **S1** a `warning` in `validateChartBindings` when `seriesBy === xAxis` (the pivot would make every x bucket its own series); **S2** the `chart` row's stale `groupBy` sentence in the liveness note.

Dedupe words: report chart seriesBy renderer, DatasetReportChart second dimension, buildChartSeries report.

Links back: #27974, PR #28191.

Blocked-by: #28191
